title: Multiacc PokeIdle — Design
summary: Approved architecture design for running multiple PokeIdle accounts in Docker workers, orchestrated by a local control-plane and Next.js UI against a central Fastify+Postgres API.
scope: AES-256-GCM encryption of PokeIdle credentials and tokens
Next.js UI (login, accounts dashboard, account form, updates)
TokenProvider login strategy (Turnstile solver primary, pasted token fallback)
update flow (GET /version every 6h, rolling recreate, ephemeral updater, :stable tag, digest rollback)
central data model (users, refresh_tokens, accounts, releases)
Vitest testing strategy (unit, integration with DinD, E2E smoke with mpw-worker-mock)
risks (Turnstile solver, game protocol, VPS dependency, PokeIdle ToS)
